exit 0
--- stdout
Add a new task to state.yaml with the specified properties.
Task details can be provided via CLI flags or loaded from a YAML file using --file.
When using --file, CLI flags can override specific fields from the file.
provider_dependencies is a YAML-file field for selected provider outputs,
including unborn children. It requires an existing provider and its configured
per-subtask transition; claim waits for that provider and selected children
MERGED plus the executed transition. Ordinary downstream depends_on stays invalid.
Updates sprint.scope.planned, goal.alignment_history, and logs the action.
Validates the added task and reports a warning if unrelated existing state
corruption keeps full-state validation degraded after the add.
For explicitly commissioned corrective planning work, supply planning_change
with kind (correction or replan), trigger, and original_task_id. CLI overrides
are --planning-change-kind, --trigger, and --planning-change-original.
Example YAML file format:
id: task-1
description: Implement feature X
spec_ref: specs/vision.md
done_when: Feature X is implemented and tested
validation:
- make test
destructive_db: false
scope: Add feature X to the codebase
role_pair: coding-pair
priority: 1
depends_on:
- task-0
provider_dependencies:
- provider_task: provider-architecture
transition: architecture-to-code-plan
outputs: [0, 2]
Usage:
liza add-task [flags]
Flags:
--agent-id string agent identifier (overrides LIZA_AGENT_ID env var; legacy env alias is also accepted)
--depends string comma-separated list of task IDs this task depends on (overrides file value)
--desc string task description (required unless using --file)
--destructive-db mark task validation as destructive to DB state; commands must start with LIZA_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_DB=1
--done string done-when criteria (required unless using --file)
--file string path to YAML file containing task details
-h, --help help for add-task
--id string task ID (required unless using --file)
--json output result as structured JSON
--log string path to log.yaml (default: .liza/log.yaml)
--planning-change-kind string corrective planning work kind: correction or replan
--planning-change-original string existing original plan for corrective planning metrics
--priority int task priority (default: 1, overrides file value)
--role-pair string task role-pair used for pipeline state and default type (required unless provided by --file)
--scope string task scope (required unless using --file)
--spec string spec reference (required unless using --file)
--state string path to state.yaml (default: .liza/state.yaml)
--trigger string explicit cause of corrective planning work
--type string optional task type override (default: derived from --role-pair or file role_pair)
--validation stringArray canonical validation command; repeat for multiple commands (overrides file value)
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
